about_the_game:
🐾 Cozy hand-drawn puzzle! 🐾
Discover cute animals, organise them to fit the grid, and get hypnotised with their eyes!

🐾 A cozy puzzle game with fluffy, goggle-eyed animals. 🐾

Find the perfect spot for all your quirky animal friends in Eyes That Hypnotise, a charming puzzle adventure filled with funny big-eyed stares and relaxing vibes. Place adorable creatures on the grid, watch their eyes follow your every move, and uncover a world of cozy, handcrafted puzzles.

✨ Will their hypnotic gaze help you solve the puzzle… or completely distract you? ✨

🧩 Key Features

🧠 60 Handcrafted Levels
Each puzzle is carefully designed to tickle your brain while keeping things chill and relaxing.

🌎 5 Unique Chapters
Explore different cozy environments—Home, City, Farm, Forest, and Exotic—each with its own set of adorable creatures and charming backgrounds.

🦉 30 Big-Eyed, Quirky Animals
Collect a variety of funny, expressive creatures, from a snooty borzoi to a sneaky rat, each with a personality of its own.

👀 Hilarious, Interactive Eyes
Animals’ eyes follow your cursor, creating funny, goofy expressions. And when you solve a puzzle—watch their eyes sparkle with pure joy!

📖 Animals Collection
Unlock and collect every fluffy friend, then admire them in your animals collection!

🧠 Multiple Solutions for Every Puzzle
Think outside the box! Each puzzle has several valid solutions, giving you space to experiment and play your way.

💡 A Hint System That Helps—Without Spoiling the Fun
Stuck? No worries! Our hint system gives gentle nudges while letting you keep the fun of discovery.

🖌 Charming Hand-Drawn Art & Animations
Each animal is lovingly illustrated and animated to bring out its personality.

🎶 Relaxing Music & Cozy Sound Design
Enjoy a soothing jazz soundtrack that makes puzzle-solving a relaxing escape.

📔 A Crafty Notebook Interface
The game’s UI feels like a cozy scrapbook, adding to its warm and inviting atmosphere.

😆 Funny & Playful Vibes
Mess with the animals’ eyes, find all the creatures, enjoy the music, and just have fun!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz or faster processor (Apple Silicon & Intel supported)
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal or OpenGL 3
  • Storage: 135 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Catalina 10.15+
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz or faster processor (Apple Silicon & Intel supported)
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal or OpenGL 3
  • Storage: 135 MB available space

short_description: Eyes That Hypnotise is a cozy puzzle that literally stares back at you! Arrange fluffy friends to fit the grid, solve handcrafted levels, and collect funny creatures. With big, hypnotic eyes and a calming mood, this game offers a relaxing escape.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
